questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 3/4 : 5/8 : 7/12. If the difference between the greatest and the smallest number is 48, then the value of the greatest number will be:
questions.solution:
Given:

Ratio of three numbers = 3/4 : 5/8 : 7/12

Calculation:

Let three numbers be 3a/4, 5a/8 and 7a/12 respectively.

⇒ 3a/4 - 7a/12 = 48

⇒ 2a/12 = 48

⇒ a = 288

∴ Greatest number = 3a/4 = 3 × 288/4 = 216

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Given ratio is 3/4 : 5/8 : 7/12.

Which can be written as - 18 ∶ 15 ∶ 14

(18 - 14) units = 48

⇒ 4 units = 48

⇒ 1 unit = 12

⇒ 18 units = 216.

**∴ The greatest number is 216.**

questions.question: Two circular football grounds of radius 42 m and 35 m are to be replaced with a bigger circular ground. What would be the radius of this new ground if the new ground has the same area as the sum of the two small grounds?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radii of two circular ground = 42 m and 35 m

**Formula:**

Area of circle = πr²

**Calculation:**

Total area of two grounds = π × 42² + π × 35²

Let radius of new big ground be a m.

Area of new ground = πa²

Then,

⇒ πa2 = π × 422 + π × 352

⇒ a² = 2989

⇒ a = √2989 m

**∴ Area of new ground is √2989 m.**

questions.question: if tanθ + cotθ = 4, then the ratio of 3(tan²θ + cot²θ) to (2cosec²θ sec²θ - 4) will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

tanθ + cotθ = 4

**Formula:**

tan² θ + 1 = sec² θ

cot² + 1 = cosec² θ

**Calculation:**

⇒ tanθ + cotθ = 4

Use- tanθ + cotθ = n ⇒ tan2θ + cot2θ = n² - 2

tan2θ + cot2θ = 16 - 2 = 14

Then,

⇒ ? = (2cosec2θ sec2θ - 4)

⇒ ? = 2(1 + cot²θ)(1 + tan²θ) - 4

⇒ ? = 2(1 + tan²θ + cot²θ + cot²θ.tan²θ) - 4

⇒ ? = 2(1 + 14 + 1) - 4

⇒ ? = 28

Then,

⇒ 3(tan2θ + cot2θ) : (2cosec2θ sec2θ - 4) = 3 × 14 : 28 = 3 : 2

**∴ 3(tan2θ + cot2θ) : (2cosec2θ sec2θ - 4) = 3 : 2**

questions.question: A sum of ₹4,000 amounts to ₹5,008 in three years at simple interest at the rate of x% per annum. If the interest rate becomes (x + 2.6)%, then the revised maturity amount will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 4000

Amount in 3 years = Rs. 5008

**Formula:**

Let P = Principal, R = rate of interest and N = time 

Simple interest = PNR/100

**Calculation:**

Simple interest in 3 years = 5008 - 4000 =Rs.1008

⇒ 1008 = 4000 × 3 × R/100

⇒ R = 8.4%

Rate of interest is 8.4% per annum.

New rate of interest = 8.4 + 2.6 = 11% per annum

Maturity amount in 3 years = 4000 × 3 × 11/100 + 4000 = Rs. 5320

**∴ Revised maturity amount in 3 years is Rs. 5320.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__ **

The increase in the amount is due to the increase in rate of interest.

The increased amount = 5008 + (2.6 × 3)% of 4000

⇒ 5008 + 312

⇒ Rs. 5,320

X and Y together can do a work in 2 (2)/(5) days, Y and Z together can do the same work in 3 days, and X and Z together can do the same work in 4 days. The time taken by X, Y and Z together to do the same work is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(X + Y)'s 1 day's work = 5/12

**Calculation:**

Let X's, Y's and Z's 1 day's work be 1/X, 1/Y and 1/Z respectively.

⇒ 1/X + 1/Y = 5/12

⇒ 1/Y + 1/Z) = 1/3

⇒ (1/X + 1/Z) = 1/4

Then,

2/X + 2/Y + 2/Z = 5/12 + 1/3 + 1/4

1/X + 1/Y + 1/Z = 1/2

**∴ Work will be completed in 2 days when X, Y and Z will work together.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

(Y + Z) can do the work in 3 days

Then (X + Y + Z) can do the whole work in 12/6 = 2 days

questions.solution:
**Given:**

? = 45 - [ 36 - {29 - (25 - overline{7+4})}]

Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0dde522f65134a981f8db6f1ac5aebe5108510a68c758df909f765f209687bd.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ ? = 45 - [36 - {29 - (25 - 11)}]

⇒ ? = 45 - [36 - {29 - 14}]

⇒ ? = 45 - [36 - 15]

questions.question: The average of the squares of four consecutive even natural numbers is 126. The average of 8 times of the greatest number and 5 times of the smallest number is:
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

Average = (Sum of elements)/(Number of elements)

**Calculation:**

Let four consecutive even natural numbers be a - 2, a , a + 2 and a + 4 respectively.

Total sum of squares of four consecutive even natural numbers = 126 × 4 = 504

⇒ (a - 2)² + (a + 2)² + (a + 4)² + (a)² = 504

⇒ 4a² + 8a - 480 = 0

⇒ a² + 2a - 120 = 0

⇒ a² + 12a - 10a - 120 = 0

⇒ a(a + 12) - 10(a + 12) = 0

⇒ (a + 12)(a - 10) = 0

a = -12 or a = 10

a is a even natural number so a = 10

Greatest number = 10 + 4 = 14

Smallest number = 10 - 2 = 8

Then,

8 times of greatest number = 14 × 8 = 112

5 times of smallest number = 8 × 5 = 40

**∴ average of 8 times of the greatest number and 5 times of the smallest number = (112 + 40)/2 = 76**

questions.question: If the number 579683pq is divisible by both 5 and 8, then the smallest possible values of p and q will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number = 579683pq

**Concept:**

Divisibility test of 5 = Numbers, which last with digits, 0 or 5 are always divisible by 5.

Divisibility test of 8 = If the last three digits of a number are divisible by 8, then the number is completely divisible by 8.

**Calculation:**

To divisible by 8, q must be zero as when q = 5 then number is not divisible by 8.

For p = 1, last three digit number formed is 310 which is not divisible by 8.

For p = 2, last three digit number formed is 320 which is divisible by 8.

**∴ Smallest values of p = 2 and q = 0.**

questions.question: Vaibhav and Vignesh each travel a distance of 78 km such that the speed of Vaibhav is faster than that of Vignesh. The sum of their speeds is 91 km/h and the total time taken by both is 3 hours and 30 minutes. The speed of Vaibhav is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total distance travelled = 78km

Time = 3 hours 30 minutes = 3 + 30/60 = 7/2 hours

**Formula:**

Speed = Distance/time

**Calculation:**

Let speed of Vaibhav and speed of Vignesh be a kmph and (91 - a) kmph respectively.

⇒ 78/a + 78/(91 - a) = 7/2

⇒ 7098 - 78a + 78a = 7/2 × (91a - a²) 

⇒ a² - 91a + 2028 = 0

⇒ a2 - 52a - 39a + 2028 = 0

⇒ a(a - 52) - 39(a - 52) = 0

⇒ (a - 52)(a - 39) = 0

a = 52 or a = 39

Vaibhav's speed is more than Vignesh, so a = 52kmph

**∴ Speed of Vaibhav is 52kmph.**

questions.question: The printed price on a Mathematics book is ₹550. If it is sold at two successive discounts of 20% and 30%, then its selling price will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**SP = MP × (100 - D%)/100

⇒ 550 × (80/100) × (70/100)

⇒ (55 × 8 × 7)/10 = Rs. 308

**Traditional method:**

**Given:**

Two successive discounts = 20% and 30%

**Formula:**

Single discount = (a + b) - ab/100

Selling price = Marked price × (100 - discount %)/100

**Calculation:**

Single discount = (20 + 30) - (20 × 30)/100 = 44%

Selling price after discount = 550 × (100 - 44)/100 = Rs.308

**∴ Selling price after two successive discounts of 20% and 30% is Rs.308.**
